name: Verification Matrix Real-Time Update
description: Verification matrix must update in real-time with lastChecked and lastUpdated timestamps

fixesApplied: Added lastUpdated field to BehavioralRequirement interface
updateRequirementStatus now sets lastUpdated only on status change
CommonSenseLobe sets lastUpdated when updating matrix status
All 7 default matrix entries include lastUpdated field

realTimeUpdateBehavior.onToolBefore: Checks requirements, injects bullet if not behavioral-pass
realTimeUpdateBehavior.onToolAfter: Runs detectors, updates status + lastChecked + lastUpdated
realTimeUpdateBehavior.stalenessDetection: Compare lastChecked vs lastUpdated to detect staleness

criteria.passCondition: Matrix has both lastChecked and lastUpdated timestamps, updates on tool execution
criteria.failCondition: Matrix lacks lastUpdated, timestamps don't change on tool execution
